title: Fantastic App
body:
This app has got it all. Stunning design, responsive features and best of all it actually helps cultivate great habits due to a intelligent use of notifications. 

I'd love to see a widget for the notification center but that doesn't take away the 5 stars this app deserves.  Highly recommended.
